newsitem.title: USA: US late spot heat clings to steep trajectory.
newsitem.headline: US late spot heat clings to steep trajectory.

text.p: U.S. heating oil held to its steep trajectory by late Wednesday, jumping over one cent in both centers on November futures and bullish inventory data showing a continuation of below-normal builds ahead of winter.
Most gasoline grades, meanwhile, lost ground amid moderately lower futures and mixed differentials, players said.
"Heat looks like it just won't slow down and wants to keep climbing as high as it can," said one Gulf Coast trader, who noted all the gain came on the NYMEX screen as differentials remained in place.
"Low U.S. stocks and firm IPE gasoil are dragging us higher," he added, but cited thin activity.
Heating oil diffs were also little changed in New York Harbor, players said, with prompt material offered at about 0.60 cents above November futures.
This morning, the EIA reported a draw of 800,000 barrels in total distillate stocks, compared with a slight 17,000-barrel reduction estimated Tuesday by the API for the week ended September 27.
